title: SimBrief Alternate Airport Usage Rate
dataSources: Flight logs (`flight:log`), flight-plan snapshots (`simbrief:plan`), network sessions (`vatsim:session`), prep tasks (`checkride:prep`), export syncs (`flight:export`).
app: Aviation and flight-sim telemetry — ForeFlight exports, SimBrief flight plans, VATSIM session logs, and checkride-prep trackers — streamed to Splunk HEC via exports and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=simbrief:plan route_type=* alternate_used=*
| stats count as total, sum(eval(if(alternate_used="yes",1,0))) as matched by route_type
| eval an_alternate_airport_pct=round(100*matched/total,1)
| sort - an_alternate_airport_pct
description: Measures the percentage of SimBrief flight plans that end with an alternate airport by route type.
value: Completion and exception percentages make it easier to spot which route type are helping or hurting SimBrief flight plans.
implementation: Store a normalized flag for `an alternate airport` on `simbrief:plan` events and summarize the hit rate by `route_type`.
visualization: Table of route type with percentage of SimBrief flight plans ending with an alternate airport.
grandmaExplanation: It gathers how often an alternate airport happens for each route type so you can see where SimBrief flight plans go smoothly or get stuck.
